verdict.rationale: AMD's own GAIA framework (linked as Ryzen AI Software for developers) exposes a CLI (e.g. 'gaia hub install email') along with agent orchestration, MCP integration, and plugin distribution via PyPI, showing an official AI-native CLI tied to Ryzen hardware. However, the evidence is thin on formal CLI reference documentation or independent hands-on verification of the CLI itself. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI command reference/docs, independent/third-party confirmation of CLI usage and reliability.
